description: PV holds row headings g (g1, g2, g3, Null), pivot candidates p (Text with Null), pl (Long), pc (Currency) and pb (Yes/No), and Amt with a Null. Which fixed PIVOT ... IN forms are accepted, with which column names, Types and order, and with which cells (error numbers where refused): a Null member, an empty list, expression members, mixed Text/Long members, Long members against a Text pivot, eight members of which five are absent, an undeclared name, a subquery, the empty string, only Null, Long lists in several orders with a duplicate-valued pair (1.0, 1) and a fraction, Yes/No lists spelled True/False and 0/-1, Currency members, and two malformed spellings? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
